meta.title: Budget and Spending
meta.description: Budgeting, tax and spending case studies: Roth conversions, ACA subsidies and real family savings.

posts.title: Credit-Card Delinquency Just Hit Great Recession Levels. Look Closer.
posts.desc: Card delinquency hit Great Recession levels — but the number is mostly old debt, not new distress. New delinquencies have been flat since early 2024.
posts.imageAlt: A blank sage card and a stack of envelopes on a wooden kitchen table beside a ceramic mug

posts.title: America Got Richer. The Bottom Got Poorer.
posts.desc: The average American family has never been worth more on paper — but the gains went to the top of the pyramid. The bottom quarter's median net worth fell 55% while the top tenth's rose 19%.
posts.imageAlt: A modest brick storefront with a green awning and a tree, with glass office towers rising behind it

posts.title: Why Employer Health Insurance Costs Are Rising in 2027
posts.desc: Employers expect an 8.2% jump in 2027, the most since 2003. The drivers, from GLP-1s to No Surprises Act disputes, charted from Mercer, KFF and CMS data, plus an open-enrollment checklist.
posts.imageAlt: A cream envelope, reading glasses, and a cup of coffee on a sage linen runner

posts.title: Roth Conversions: Compressing Tax Liabilities Pre-Medicare
posts.desc: How Roth conversions during lower-income gap years before Medicare can compress lifetime tax liabilities and reduce IRMAA exposure. Educational only.
posts.imageAlt: A calculator, a cup of coffee, and a stack of blank papers on a wooden desk

posts.title: Navigating Early Retirement ACA Premium Tax Subsidies
posts.desc: Mechanical frameworks for monitoring MAGI to pursue ACA premium tax credit savings in early retirement. Educational only, not advice.
posts.imageAlt: A cream notebook, reading glasses, a plant, and a sage mug on a linen table

posts.title: How a Family of 5 Saved $1,210 on Their Disneyland Trip
posts.desc: A worked example: how a family of five cut 20% off a 4-day Disneyland California trip with discounted tickets, tracked fares, opaque hotel rates and stacked credit card rewards.
posts.imageAlt: A family of five walking toward a glowing theme-park castle at dusk under fireworks
